name: Mall Wall Corner · 2 m
summary: A 90° turn for the two-metre limestone interior wall, with continuous bronze trims.
description: Two 2 m centreline arms enclose a mitered backing and trim. Separate arm meshes preserve the clear inside aisle. All three authored detail levels mate to the straight family.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: The actual original straight-wall Blender profiles were extended to a shared miter. Packed original project stone artwork supplies the close level.

assembly.origin: finished floor at the 90-degree centreline turn

rights: Original project asset. Public download and redistribution terms have not been specified.

attribution.credit: Original Blender-3D-Gallery geometry and render. Uses the original honed limestone texture and finish profiles from mall-wall-module-2m.

accuracy_notes: Fictional interior corner for the 2 m wall grid. The 90° turn and two straight joins were measured. Other wall families, installation, physical-device performance and building ratings require separate review.
